FFmpeg 8.0.1 is built without external codecs, network support or GPL options.
Its LGPL-2.1-or-later source and license are supplied in zhile-source.zip.
No Xabe precompiled FFmpeg binaries are distributed in 知乐 releases.
The Go/Android/JDK toolchains are separately installed system build tools.

2026-10-30: Zhile v0.2.0 adds discovery, mobile navigation, a listening-first
player and optional landing-page motion. Mood photography and design concepts
